svg.title: Fleet Courier - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: High Guard Update 2022, printed 183-184, PDF 184-185. Combined three-deck envelope retains broad rounded bow, near-parallel aft sides, shoulder steps and four exposed stern drive ends. Fuel deck follows same outer hull; smaller upper deck is contained. Shared grid/beam and illustration support alignment. Illustration corroborates blunt rounded courier form. Interior room borders and detached turrets excluded.
